dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Uses COPY with REPLACING using // delimiters typical of GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL conventions.
evidence: No EXEC CICS or EXEC SQL

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (Rezept) software for Japanese medical billing - specifically the inpatient receipt comment editing component
purpose.summary: ORCR0660 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that handles comment editing for inpatient (nyuin) receipts. It reads and processes indexed receipt data files (RECE62, RECE64, RECE65 and variants) to generate or update comment records associated with medical billing claims, including handling of rehabilitation therapy schedules, drug management guidance fees, and various date-based comment fields.

notable_features: 31 COPY statements with REPLACING using // delimiter syntax
35 CALL statements indicating heavy use of subprograms
231 PERFORM statements with no GOTO (structured programming)
Multiple indexed files with DYNAMIC and SEQUENTIAL access
OCCURS tables for calendar/schedule data (31-day arrays)
Japanese EUC-encoded comments (latin-1 decoded with mojibake)
No COMP-3 usage despite numeric fields
verdict.notes: Source is encoded in EUC-JP (Japanese) but decoded as latin-1, resulting in mojibake in comment lines. The program logic and structure are clearly readable. File is truncated at 16000 chars out of 157473 bytes total (3528 lines). The // REPLACING delimiter is characteristic of GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL rather than IBM mainframe COBOL.
